entries.claim: The workflow now offers to resume incomplete or paused work rather than automatically resuming it.
entries.failure_scenario: Running `/cad-progress` with an incomplete or paused phase still follows the pre-existing automatic routing/handoff: this diff changes only the purpose text (the 19-byte workflow budget increase is fully accounted for by that wording) and does not add an ask-user gate or alter any dispatch step. The command can therefore begin/resume work without consent while README, COMMANDS, and the skill description promise only an offer.

counter_evidence.note: The ask-user gate the finding says is absent is already there and predates this diff. progress.md:233-235 ends the route step with Offer the suggestion through the ask-user seam (references/seam-ask-user.md), 1. Continue now - invoke the suggested skill, 2. Stop here - report only; the handoff step at line 239 begins If the user chose to continue; and the guardrails close with Never invoke a spine skill without the user accepting the offer. That is why plan 4 changed only the wording - the behaviour already matched offers to resume, and the defect was three documents promising an automatic one.
